title: Evaluating ChatGPT's Performance for Multilingual and Emoji-based Hate Speech Detection
measurement_description: The paper measured the performance of ChatGPT in detecting hate speech targeting protected groups, which included religious groups like Muslims and Jews, across multiple languages.
findings: The model's performance in identifying hate speech against religious groups varied across languages. For instance, it achieved a macro F1 score of 86.0 for hate speech targeting Muslims in English and 84.6 in French. Performance for hate speech targeting Jews was measured in Arabic (macro F1 of 68.9) and Italian (macro F1 of 75.1).
